name: MsgDraftGenerationV1
steps: validate bounded recipients/content and compute content_fingerprint from StrictVersionedJson semantic input
inside short UoW insert/reuse immutable msg_draft identity by origin_command_id + content_fingerprint and record generation audit; commit
build IPM.Note bytes with msgforge 1.0.0 outside transaction; sent flag false; no send API/COM/Outlook invocation
verify CFB/OXMSG structure with independent verifier and SHA-256 artifact bytes
publish file atomically to operator-selected destination; then record export metadata in short UoW and audit
if export fails, generated draft provenance may remain GENERATED; retry can republish same semantic draft without creating sent Communication
later PST/OST discovery follows normal CanonicalMessageIdentityV1; reviewed reconciliation may set reconciled_communication_id but draft identity remains distinct
rules: draft/export never changes source coverage/high-water or communication sent counts
draft bodies are local authored evidence, not provider source evidence
